cta.label: Explore how you can build on Azure

blocks.heading:
Get Amp’d to move from a
Microsoft data estate to agents
inside Microsoft 365
blocks.body: An Azure estate earns its keep when the business can ask it something. Amp’d is how Agivant gets there. Bolt scaffolds the agent stack, Forward Deployed Engineers build inside the enterprise’s own Azure tenant, and production grade agents answer through the Copilot surface people already use. Each engagement ships with evaluation and rollback, and every hardened pipeline, semantic definition, and agent pattern becomes a reusable asset the next build starts from. Every build amplifies the next.

media.alt: Get Amp’d to move from a Microsoft data estate to agents inside Microsoft 365

data.heading:
Why Azure puts answers where the
work already happens
data.description: If your identity sits in Entra ID and your work happens in Microsoft 365, the shortest route to AI adoption runs through the tools already on the desk. Answers show up where people work, on a security setup the company already trusts, and nobody has to learn a new application to get them. Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse Analytics work from OneLake and Azure Data Lake Storage, so the data stays in one place and stays useful.

media.alt: Why Azure puts answers where the work already happens

blocks.heading:
Keep teams in control while agents
work inside Microsoft 365.
blocks.body: Every Agivant agent is production grade from day one, observable and always on. Each agent holds its own identity in Microsoft Entra ID, so access is granted, reviewed, and revoked the way it is for people. Routine steps run on their own, and anything carrying money or risk waits for the person who owns the decision.

media.alt: Keep teams in control while agents work inside Microsoft 365

data.heading: FinOps, sized before workloads go live.
data.description: Azure capacity is easy to buy and easy to leave running. Agivant sizes it against real workload patterns and sets token budgets before anything reaches production, so financial accountability, visibility, and cost efficiency are part of the architecture rather than a cleanup exercise two quarters later.

media.alt: FinOps sized before Azure workloads go live

blocks.body: Token budgets per agent and per use case, with prompt caching and batch processing in Azure OpenAI
Provisioned throughput for steady workloads and pay-as-you-go for spiky ones, chosen per use case
Microsoft Cost Management budgets and cost tags showing spend by team and use case
Fabric capacity paused when idle, with Synapse serverless pools for occasional queries
lower token spend and up to 30% lower Azure capacity cost

blocks.heading:
Scale on Azure with
identity-first engineering.
blocks.body: Agivant connects through native Azure services and the Microsoft 365 surfaces the enterprise already runs, so data, agents, and applications sit inside your own tenant. Forward Deployed Engineers work in focused sprints, and every agent is registered in Microsoft Entra ID before it touches a workflow. This is what an Amp’d enterprise looks like in production.

media.alt: Scale on Azure with identity-first engineering
